5.6.23 Rte_IStatus Purpose: Provide the error status of a VariableDataPrototype referenced by a VariableAccess in the dataReadAccess role. Signature: [SWS_Rte_02599] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00147, SRS_Rte_00078 ⌈ Std_ReturnType Rte_[Byps_]IStatus__

_( [IN Rte_Instance ], [OUT Std_TransformerError transformerError]) Where is the short name of the RunnableEntity,

the port name and the VariableDataPrototype short name. [Byps_] is an optional infix used when component wrapper method for bypass support is enabled for the related software component type.⌋ Existence: [SWS_Rte_02600] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00147, SRS_Rte_00078 ⌈An Rte_IStatus API shall be created for a required VariableDataPrototype if a RunnableEntity has a VariableAccess in the dataReadAccess role referring to this VariableDataPrototype, and • if at the RPortPrototype or PRPortPrototype a NonqueuedReceiverComSpec with either – the attribute aliveTimeout set to a value greater than zero and/or – the attribute handleNeverReceived set to TRUE and/or – the attribute handleOutOfRange not set to none and/or – the attribute handleDataStatus set to TRUE and/or • if at the SenderReceiverInterface classifying the RPortPrototype or PRPortPrototype an InvalidationPolicy set to keep is specified for this VariableDataPrototype.⌋ [SWS_Rte_CONSTR_09027] Rte_IStatus API shall only be used by a RunnableEntity describing an read access to the related data ⌈The Rte_IStatus API shall only be used by a RunnableEntity that has a VariableAccess in the dataReadAccess role referring to the VariableDataPrototype to which the status belongs.⌋ [SWS_Rte_08568] Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00249 ⌈The optional OUT parameter transformerError of the API shall be generated if the PortPrototype of port

is referenced by a PortAPIOption which has the attribute errorHandling set to transformerErrorHandling.⌋ Description: The Rte_IStatus API provides access to the current status of the data e…
